_comment: Every operation listed here must be (a) present in contracts/http/v1/openapi.json,
(b) implemented by the named Python and TypeScript SDK methods, and (c) actually
EXERCISED against the real AgentRouter ASGI app by the parity tests.
Listing an operation without exercising it is a failure, not a claim of support.
Python: tests/test_sdk_parity.py drives an in-process uvicorn server on loopback.
TypeScript: sdk/typescript/test/live.test.ts drives the same app started by
scripts/serve_for_parity.py, so a request the server would reject cannot pass.

behaviours.error_envelope: non-2xx bodies are {"error": {"code", "message"}}; both SDKs raise a typed error carrying status + code
behaviours.non_json_error_body: a non-JSON error body must still raise the typed error, never a parse error
behaviours.auth_header: X-API-Key when an api key is configured
behaviours.request_id: server returns X-Request-ID on every response, including errors
behaviours.idempotency_key: Idempotency-Key on authenticated POSTs; replay marked by Idempotency-Replay
behaviours.rate_limit: 429 with code rate_limited and a Retry-After header
behaviours.timeouts: client-side timeout is configurable (Python: timeout, TypeScript: timeoutMs)
behaviours.body_cleaning: None/undefined fields are dropped so server defaults apply; explicit false/0 are kept
behaviours.additive_host_fields: hosts entries expose state and remedy alongside availability/reason
behaviours.catalog_diagnostics: host entries carry the diagnostic fields the CLI doctor surfaces
